title: Finite geometric stalks from finite constant models
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, X a scheme, and F a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on X_proet having finite constant models after a pro-etale covering family. For every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ in the scheme universe and x:Spec $\Omega$$\to$X, the fixed-module geometric stalk [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk] of F at x is finite.

source.place: Tags 099Y and 09AK; fixed-module coefficients and finite global stratifications

proof.text: The fiber functor sends U to the lifts of x to U. Its element category is equivalent to the pointed geometric-neighborhood category [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]. This gives the required cofilteredness and identifies the specified colimit with its sheaf fiber. A cover lifts x over the same algebraically closed field: select a point above its image, base change to Ω, and split the weakly etale map. Thus this fiber functor is a site point.

Transport the finite models to slices using [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-finite-model-local-constancy]. Lift the terminal fiber element through this cover and factor through a generating member. Its fiber in the slice equals the original fiber, by finality of the cofiltered over-category forgetful functor. The fiber of the constant sheaf M is M. The local model isomorphism therefore identifies the stalk of F with finite M.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_geometricStalk_of_finite_models
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : ∃ (ι : Type (u + 1)) (W : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ X),
      Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
          Nonempty (((g i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F ≅
            (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (W i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) :
    Finite (proEtaleGeometricFixedModuleStalk x Λ F)
